Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Writing 3.1 Writing posture (3 lessons) By the end of the sub strand, the learne
Topic 3.2: Pre- writing skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Pre- writing skills, part of Writing 3.1 Writing posture (3 lessons) By the end of the sub strand, the learne in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Which materials do you require for writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Pre- writing skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration as the learner engages in pre-writing skills of

scribbling from left to right while turning pages.

• Creativity and imagination: Originality as the learner colour pictures within the borders using different colours.

• Self-efficacy is enhanced as the learner independently scribbles and colours within borders as expected.

Values:
• Responsibility is developed as the learner practices autonomy in writing by correctly holding a writing tool and scribbling.

• Integrity is developed as the learner does own work and displays it for feedback from others.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Health related issues, personal hygiene is practiced as the learner washes hands after coloring with crayons.

20

• Child safety and security is enhanced as the learner follows simple teacher given rules not to eat colour pencils and crayons

and other writing materials.

Link to other Learning Areas: Creative activities as learner model, to enhance pre writing activities.

Suggested learning resources: Books, pencils, colour pencils, sticks.
